sn47.27:1.1: Taṃ yeva nidānaṃ || || Ekam antam- -Anuruddham etad avoca || || Asekho asekho ti āvuso Anuruddha vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Asekho hotī ti || || Catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam samattam bhāvitattā asekho hoti || ||
sn47.27:2.1: Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samattā bhāvitattā asekho hotī ti || || 1--2. Taṃ
